howto.name: Upload a square image
howto.text: PNG, JPG, or SVG. PrivaTools resizes to favicon dimensions automatically.

howto.name: PrivaTools generates the favicon bundle
howto.text: Multiple resolutions (16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 192×192, 512×512) plus Apple Touch Icon + manifest.json + meta tags HTML snippet.

howto.name: Download the bundle
howto.text: Drop into your site's public/ folder, paste the meta tags into <head>.

faq.q: Do I need all those sizes?
faq.a: Yes — different browsers and devices use different sizes (16×16 for tabs, 192×192 for Android home screen, 512×512 for PWA install).

faq.q: Should I use PNG or SVG source?
faq.a: SVG is best — it stays sharp at every size. PNG works if you only have a raster logo. JPG loses some sharpness from compression.
No — favicons render exactly as uploaded. To get a circular look, upload a circular PNG with transparency.
